llms.body:
# AdvancedMD

> AdvancedMD is a cloud-based, all-in-one healthcare software platform for independent physician practices and medical billing companies, unifying EHR/EMR, practice management, medical billing, revenue cycle management (RCM), patient engagement, AI clinical documentation, and telemedicine in a single system. Serving 65,000+ practitioners across 14,000+ practices and 900+ billing companies, processing 9.5 million claims per month, across 39 medical specialties.

This file is a navigational index for AI assistants and crawlers. For the full structured company profile (background, history, key facts, certifications, awards, and FAQ), see the AI Information page linked first below.

## Company & AI Information

- [AdvancedMD AI Information](https://www.advancedmd.com/ai-information): Canonical structured company profile for AI assistants — facts, history, certifications, awards, and FAQ.
- [Our Story](https://www.advancedmd.com/company/our-story/): Company history and ownership.
- [Company](https://www.advancedmd.com/company/): About AdvancedMD.
- [Awards](https://www.advancedmd.com/company/awards/): Industry recognition and awards.
- [Integration Marketplace](https://www.advancedmd.com/integrations/marketplace/): Third-party integrations, including AI scribe partners (DAX Copilot, Dragon Medical One, DeepScribe).
- [Contact Us](https://www.advancedmd.com/company/contact-us/): Get in touch with AdvancedMD.

## Core Products & Services

- [EHR / EMR Software](https://www.advancedmd.com/emr-ehr-software/): Specialty-specific clinical workflows, documentation templates, e-prescribing, and charting.
- [Practice Management Software](https://www.advancedmd.com/medical-office-software/practice-managment/): Scheduling, check-in, eligibility verification, and front-office operations.
- [Medical Billing Software](https://www.advancedmd.com/medical-billing/software/): Claims management, clearinghouse, claims scrubbing, and denial management.
- [Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)](https://www.advancedmd.com/revenue-cycle-management/): Fully managed outsourced billing, priced at 4–8% of collections.
- [Patient Engagement](https://www.advancedmd.com/patient/): Online scheduling, digital intake, reminders, and two-way messaging.
- [Patient Portal](https://www.advancedmd.com/patient/patient-portal/): Secure portal for scheduling, intake, messaging, and payments.
- [AI Clinical Documentation](https://www.advancedmd.com/ai/): Ambient listening and AI transcription for automated clinical notes.
- [Telemedicine](https://www.advancedmd.com/patient/telemedicine-software/): HIPAA-compliant integrated video visits.
- [Analytics & Reporting](https://www.advancedmd.com/medical-billing/software/reporting/): Dashboards, business intelligence, and financial reporting.

## Pricing & Demos

- [Software Pricing](https://www.advancedmd.com/software-pricing/): Per-provider subscription pricing, bundles, and specialty-specific options.
- [Schedule a Live Demo](https://www.advancedmd.com/medical-office-software/live-demo/): Book a guided platform walkthrough.

## Current Promotions

- [Summer 2026 Offer — 3 Months Free](https://info.advancedmd.com/hot-summer-savings-w.html: 3 months free on the unified platform for new account orders placed in June 2026; free service through September 2026. (Time-sensitive — valid for June 2026 orders only.)

## Specialty Solutions

- [Specialties Overview](https://www.advancedmd.com/specialties/): All 39 supported specialties; each hub has EHR/EMR, billing & coding, and practice management sub-pages.
- [Addiction Medicine](https://www.advancedmd.com/specialties/addiction-medicine/)

## For Billing Companies

## Optional
